📢 We’re Hiring | Media Sales & Brand Solutions Executive
See who PaRa Music has hired for this role
Direct message the job poster from PaRa Music
PaRa Music is one of India's most valuable music companies — a private equity-backed, technology-led Music IP powerhouse focused on building, owning, and monetising large-scale music catalogues across India.
We combine strong content leadership with innovative digital monetisation strategies to create long-term value through music, content, and brand partnerships.
We are looking for a creative, driven, and growth-oriented Media Sales & Brand Solutions Executive to join our Revenue Team.
In this role, you will bridge the gap between media sales and content strategy by working closely with brands and advertising agencies to conceptualise, pitch, and execute innovative, content-driven advertising solutions.
The ideal candidate should have a flair for storytelling, an understanding of brand integrations, and the ability to create compelling proposals that translate creative ideas into revenue opportunities.
Brainstorm and develop creative, multi-platform brand integration and advertising solutions.
Create engaging pitch decks and customised proposals aligned with clients' marketing objectives.
Identify opportunities for brand integrations across music, digital content, and other media platforms.
Collaborate with internal creative, editorial, and production teams to develop innovative brand-led content solutions.
Identify and prospect potential brands, advertising agencies, and media partners.
Build and maintain relationships with brand representatives and agency stakeholders.
Generate new business opportunities and contribute towards achieving revenue targets.
Pitch content-led partnerships, sponsorships, and media advertising solutions.
3. Campaign Execution & Account Management
Coordinate with clients and internal teams to ensure smooth execution of branded campaigns.
Manage campaign deliverables, content approvals, and execution timelines.
Track campaign performance in collaboration with analytics and ad-operations teams.
Prepare post-campaign reports covering reach, engagement, and campaign effectiveness.
Identify opportunities for repeat business, account growth, and client retention.
Experience: 1–2 years of experience in media sales, brand solutions, content marketing, advertising, or agency client servicing.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Mass Communication, Business Administration, or a related field.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Strong creative thinking, storytelling, and proposal-writing abilities.
Basic understanding of digital media, advertising, brand integrations, and content marketing.
Proficiency in PowerPoint and presentation development.
Ability to manage multiple projects, coordinate with stakeholders, and work in a fast-paced environment.
Be part of a fast-growing, technology-led music and entertainment company.
Work on exciting brand partnerships and innovative content-led campaigns.
Collaborate with creative, content, and business teams.
Get opportunities to learn, grow, and make a direct impact on business revenue.
Interested? We would love to hear from you!
📩 Share your CV at hr@paramusic.com or apply through LinkedIn.
